# HTTP Forge

> HTTP testing, scripting, and API discovery for VS Code, CLI, and MCP. Postman-compatible script API (pm/ctx/hf), template syntax, test suites, environments, and AI-assisted test generation.

## Quick Start

- Install the VS Code extension: search "HTTP Forge" in the marketplace
- Or install the CLI: `npm install -g @http-forge/cli`
- Create a collection: use the sidebar or `http-forge` CLI
- Write scripts in `post-response.js` using `pm.test()` and `pm.expect()`
- Run: `http-forge run collection <name> --env <env> --json`

## Script API
- Globals type definitions: https://github.com/hsl1230/http-forge/blob/main/http-forge.core/src/infrastructure/collection/templates/http-forge-globals.d.ts

### Key globals
- `pm` / `ctx` / `hf` — interchangeable aliases for the Postman-compatible API
- `pm.test(name, fn)` — register a test case
- `pm.expect(value)` — Chai-style assertions (equal, eql, have.property, jsonSchema, be.ok/true/false/null/empty, not, include, contain, match, above, below, within, instanceOf, throw, change, increase, decrease, by, etc.)
- `pm.response` — code, status, statusText, body, headers, cookies, responseTime, responseSize, json(), text(), reason()
- `pm.response.to.have.status(code)` / `.header(name, value?)` / `.body()` / `.jsonBody()` / `.jsonSchema(schema)`
- `pm.response.to.be.ok / .success / .error / .clientError / .serverError`
- `pm.request` — method, url (Postman Url object), headers, body, params, query, auth
- `pm.environment` / `pm.globals` / `pm.collectionVariables` / `pm.variables` — variable scopes (get, set, has, unset, clear, toObject, replaceIn)
- `pm.cookies` — get, set, has, list, toObject, jar
- `pm.execution` — setNextRequest, skipRequest, runRequest, location
- `pm.visualizer` — set, clear
- `pm.iterationData` — data-driven iteration variables
- `pm.sendRequest(urlOrOptions, callback?)` — standalone HTTP call
- `postman` — legacy Postman namespace (setGlobalVariable, setEnvironmentVariable, getResponseHeader, etc.)
- `CryptoJS`, `moment`, `_` (lodash), `querystring`, `require`, `console`, `Buffer`, `URL`, `atob`/`btoa`

### Template syntax
- `{{variableName}}` — variable interpolation
- `{{value | upper | trim}}` — filter chain
- `{{$guid}}`, `{{$timestamp}}`, `{{$randomInt}}` — dynamic variables
- `{{variable | date:'YYYY-MM-DD'}}` — filter with argument

## Packages
- http-forge (VS Code extension): https://github.com/hsl1230/http-forge
- http-forge.core (runtime engine): https://github.com/hsl1230/http-forge/tree/main/http-forge.core
- http-forge.cli (CLI): https://github.com/hsl1230/http-forge/tree/main/http-forge.cli

## Key concepts
- Collections, requests, folders, environments, scripts (pre-request/post-response)
- Template syntax: {{variable}}, {{$guid}}, {{value | upper | trim}}
- Script API: pm/ctx/hf (aliases), pm.test(), pm.expect() (Chai-style), pm.response, pm.request, pm.execution, pm.visualizer
- Postman-compatible: pm.sendRequest, pm.setNextRequest, postman.* legacy globals
- MCP server for AI-driven testing (run, discover, generate, suggest assertions, heal)
- API discovery from source (Express, Nest, Fastify, Lambda, Spring, FastAPI)
- OpenAPI import/export, collection enhancement, environment suggestions
- Test suites with control flow (if/for/while/switch/block/script nodes)
- Data-driven testing with CSV/JSON iteration data
- Business context via .http-forge/knowledge/ markdown files
